content.title: Man City vs. Real Madrid Prediction, Pick, XIs for Champions League Today
content.text: One of the biggest surprises in the Champions League during last week’s first-leg matchups in the round of 16 was Real Madrid trouncing Man City by the score of 3-0 at the Bernabeu. While Manchester City will return to the Etihad on Tuesday, March 17, for the second leg at 4:00 p.m. ET, live on Paramount+, they’ll have their work cut out for them to level the score and advance to the quarterfinals.Below, we’ll discuss our Man City vs. Real Madrid prediction and picks for Tuesday’s Champions League Round of 16 match at Etihad Stadium. Use PrizePicks and PrizePicks Team Picks to make your picks on players, winners, goal totals, and player stats to earn money if you're right!Man City vs. Real Madrid Prediction, Picks for Champions League – March 17, 2026The most impressive part of Madrid’s dominant performance against City last week was the fact that they were sans F Kylian Mbappe and MF Jude Bellingham. Although Mbappe will make a welcome return on Tuesday, Bellingham won’t be available despite traveling with the club. Mbappe will come off the bench if needed vs. City.With Real Madrid being without a few of their premier players in their first-leg clash against Man City, it was MF Federico Valverde who stepped up with an impressive hat trick. On the other hand, City failed to convert any of their 9 shots into a goal.Entering Tuesday’s match, Man City is running out of time to catch Arsenal in the Premier League race, as they sit nine points behind the first-place club. Real Madrid are also in second place in the La Liga table, but they find themselves only four points behind first-place Barcelona.Man City vs. Real Madrid Spread, Total Goals, PayoutsDespite being up 3-0 on aggregate, Real Madrid enters Tuesday’s match as road underdogs, returning a 5x payout — $100 entry pays out $500 — on PrizePicks Team Picks if they win outright.Man City are home favorites with a 1.44x ($144 payout on a $100 entry) payout if they secure a victory, via PrizePicks Team Picks.Winner Payout: Real Madrid – 5x | Tie – 5x | Man City – 1.44xSpread: Man City -1.5 (2.04x Payout)Total Goals: 3.5 (Over – 2.04x)Both Teams to Score: Yes 1.58x | No 2.38xTeam Picks data is live at the time of writing and is subject to change.
